api_url.hint: 填写你的 Nai2API 服务地址，例如 https://nai.sta1n.cn

token.hint: 后台生成的 STA1N-xxx 用户密钥

default_model.hint: NovelAI 模型名称。V5 (5-full / 5-curated) 支持极高二次元细节与自然语言提示，普通尺寸消耗 5 点；V4.5 / V4 消耗 1 点

default_steps.hint: 步数越高质量越好但越慢，/generate 接口最高 28

default_cfg.hint: NovelAI 的 CFG rescale 参数，0 到 1 之间，0 表示关闭

default_negative.hint: 使用 NovelAI 官方推荐的负面提示词，留空则不传
default_negative.default: {{{{bad anatomy}}}},{bad feet},bad hands,{{{bad proportions}}},{blurry},cloned face,cropped,{{{deformed}}},{{{disfigured}}},error,{{{extra arms}}},{extra digit},{{{extra legs}}},extra limbs,{{extra limbs}},{fewer digits},{{{fused fingers}}},gross proportions,jpeg artifacts,{{{{long neck}}}},low quality,{malformed limbs},{{missing arms}},{missing fingers},{{missing legs}},mutated hands,{{{mutation}}},normal quality,poorly drawn face,poorly drawn hands,signature,text,{{too many fingers}},{{{ugly}}},username,watermark,worst quality

default_preset.hint: 填预设名称（例如「动漫风」或自定义预设名）。设置后每次生图自动套用该预设（画师串/质量词 + 正向词 + 负向词），不需要每次输入 -p。在 WebUI 面板点击「设为默认」可直接切换。留空则不使用预设。

timeout.hint: Nai2API 生图可能需要较长时间，建议 120 秒以上

llm_tool_enabled.description: 允许 LLM 调用生图
llm_tool_enabled.hint: 关闭后 LLM 无法调用 nai_generate 工具

translate_enabled.hint: 开启后，提示词含中文时自动用下方选择的独立对话模型直译为英文 Danbooru 标签；纯英文/符号提示词直接使用，不调用模型。

translate_provider_id.hint: 填写 AstrBot 对话模型（provider）的 ID；留空则直译不生效。可在插件 WebUI 面板「提示词直译」中可视化选择。该功能只读取、绝不修改你的对话模型设置。

translate_system_prompt.hint: 决定直译风格与标签规范（尤其作品名/角色名如何落成 Danbooru 消歧标签）。留空时使用内置默认值。
translate_system_prompt.default:
You are a prompt translator for NovelAI image generation.
Translate the user's Chinese (or mixed Chinese/English) description into English Danbooru-style tags.

Rules:
1. Output ONLY the tags, separated by commas. No explanation, no markdown, no code fences, no quotes, no numbering, no extra sentences.
2. Use tag keywords, not sentences: write 'long hair' not 'she has long hair'.
3. If part of the input is already English tags, keep them VERBATIM; do not rewrite or reorder them.
4. PRESERVE any NovelAI weight syntax exactly as-is, never modify or renumber it: `1.2::tag::`, `{{tag}}`, `[tag]`, `-2::tag::`, `\n20::tag::`.
5. Preserve artist tags such as `artist:name` unchanged.
6. Keep the original order as much as possible.

Character and work names (MOST IMPORTANT):
7. When the user names a character from a known game / anime / manga / illustration work, output the precise Danbooru character tag in the form `character_name_(franchise_name)`, all lowercase with underscores. Examples: 原神 雷电将军 -> raiden_shogun_(genshin_impact); 崩坏3 琪亚娜 -> kiana_kaslana_(honkai_impact_3rd); 鸣潮 达妮娅 -> dania_(wuthering_waves).
8. Translate a work / franchise name on its own into its common English tag (e.g. 原神 -> genshin_impact, 崩坏3 -> honkai_impact_3rd).
9. If you do NOT know the exact Danbooru disambiguation for a character, output the romanized character name as a tag and STOP. NEVER guess how the character looks.
10. NEVER invent details the user did not mention: no hair color, eye color, hairstyle, body type, clothing, pose, or expression unless the user explicitly said it. This rule overrides everything else.
11. SUBJECT COUNT IS MANDATORY when a single person is described: put `1girl` (or `1boy`) as the FIRST tag; use `solo` if the gender is unknown. Omit it only when the user clearly asks for multiple people or a scene with no people.
12. Do NOT output two tags with the same meaning. Pick the single most accurate one: 泳装 -> swimsuit (not swimsuit + bikini); 女孩 -> 1girl (not 1girl + female).
13. Convert Chinese counters/quantifiers into tags: 双马尾 -> twintails; 两把刀 -> holding two swords.
14. Ignore non-visual instructions such as requested size or resolution.
15. When in doubt, do NOT add a tag. Too few accurate tags beats extra guessed tags.

Examples:
Input: 白发少女站在樱花树下，回头微笑
Output: 1girl, white hair, standing, cherry blossoms, tree, looking back, smile

Input: 原神 雷电将军 紫色长发 和服
Output: 1girl, raiden_shogun_(genshin_impact), purple hair, long hair, japanese clothes

Input: 战双 比安卡 泳装
Output: 1girl, bianca_(punishing:_gray_raven), swimsuit

Input: 鸣潮 达妮娅 泳装
Output: 1girl, dania_(wuthering_waves), swimsuit

Input: {{1girl}} 1.3::silver hair:: [detailed]
Output: {{1girl}}, 1.3::silver hair::, [detailed]

Input: 1girl, silver hair, looking at viewer
Output: 1girl, silver hair, looking at viewer

Input: 赛博朋克风格的城市夜景，霓虹灯，雨，氛围感
Output: cyberpunk, city, night, neon lights, rain, cinematic lighting, depth of field

Output the translated tags in a single line and nothing else.

show_image_info.hint: 开启后在图片下方显示预设名和耗时

allow_2k.hint: 关闭后使用 2K 尺寸会自动降级为普通尺寸，防止误扣 15 点

allow_4k.hint: 关闭后使用 4K 尺寸会自动降级为普通尺寸，防止误扣 25 点

max_cached_images.hint: 超过此数时清理旧缓存图
